business_problem: Royal Vopak needed to replace more than 10 localized and heavily customized finance environments so it could standardize procurement and finance processes globally, lower operating costs, and give teams visibility into detailed ledger data instead of only high-level consolidated reporting.
solution_summary: Royal Vopak replaced its fragmented JD Edwards landscape with Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP and Oracle Fusion Cloud Procurement, then layered Oracle Fusion Data Intelligence Platform and Oracle Fusion ERP Analytics on top for drill-down visibility into global finance and purchasing data. Transactional finance and procurement processes now run in one standardized cloud blueprint across countries instead of disconnected country stacks and third-party reporting workarounds. Oracle Risk Management and Compliance adds monitoring for access and transactional controls, while prebuilt analytics help the company track spend, suppliers, and process performance from a single source of truth. The integrated design lets Vopak move data once, apply standard approvals and controls globally, and serve both operational users and auditors with timely, more detailed reporting.
products_used: Oracle Fusion Cloud Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP)

solution_components.name: Oracle Fusion Cloud Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP)
solution_components.role: Runs Vopak's standardized global finance processes and centralized chart-of-accounts model.

solution_components.name: Oracle Fusion Cloud Procurement
solution_components.role: Handles global purchasing workflows and supplier-facing procurement processes on the same platform as finance.

solution_components.name: Oracle Fusion Data Intelligence Platform
solution_components.role: Provides prebuilt KPIs, predictive analytics, and drill-down reporting over integrated finance and procurement data.

solution_components.name: Oracle Fusion ERP Analytics
solution_components.role: Delivers embedded procurement and finance analytics from a single source of truth.

solution_components.name: Oracle Risk Management and Compliance
solution_components.role: Applies access and transactional controls to support monitoring and internal audit processes.

data_flow: Country-level finance and procurement transactions now flow into Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP and Procurement instead of separate localized systems; Oracle Fusion Data Intelligence Platform and Fusion ERP Analytics surface prebuilt KPIs and drill-down views over that common dataset; Oracle Risk Management and Compliance monitors approvals and access for audit and control processes.
business_outcome: Vopak completed its migration to a global finance and procurement blueprint, cut operational costs, improved controls and data consistency, and reduced report turnaround from as much as an hour to less than a minute while giving staff drill-down insight into spend, purchasing, and supplier performance.
metrics: Reports that used to take as much as an hour are now available in less than a minute
architecture_clues: Standardized global blueprint replaces country-specific customized environments
Prebuilt procurement analytics operate on a single source of truth
Access and transactional controls are built into the cloud platform for audit support
evidence_quotes: In 2022, Royal Vopak completed the migration from JDE to Oracle Cloud ERP and Oracle Fusion Cloud Procurement in 21 countries.
The prebuilt procurement analytics capabilities within Oracle Fusion ERP Analytics also helped the company better manage procurement performance.
Reports that used to take as much as an hour are now available in less than a minute.
